verdict: Yes, for the growing 'sober-curious' market. Malaki pitched non-alcoholic beverages on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Buyers who don't drink alcohol want something more interesting than soft drinks at parties, and bars want premium alcohol-free options.
angle: Mocktails, alcohol-free spirits and sparkling drinks sell to people who don't drink, drivers and health-conscious buyers. There's no excise licence needed, but these drinks must still compete for shelf space. Cafés, restaurants and events are good starting channels.
